typography.rules: Use Playfair Display exclusively on the Homepage for an editorial, high-end, premium media brand feel. Do not use Playfair on the Dashboard. Use IBM Plex Sans for all dashboard UI, data tables, and forms to maximize data legibility and functional density.

colors.strategy: CSS Custom Properties (Variables) mapped to root. Dashboard relies strictly on variables to enable the 100+ theme switcher.

core_variables.--surface-hover: Hover state for table rows and list items
core_variables.--primary: Main brand color (buttons, active navigation, links)
core_variables.--border: Dividers, input borders, and table borders

homepage_theme.description: Fixed Luxury Corporate Dark Theme. Independent of the dashboard theme switcher.

theming_system.description: The user requested 100+ preset color palettes covering Black, White, Blue, Yellow, and Red base tones for dashboard personalization.
implementation_steps: Create a standalone vanilla JS file (e.g., `theme-manager.js`).

Generate an array of at least 100 theme objects grouped by base tones (Black, White, Blue, Yellow, Red). Instead of manual typing, you can write a JS initialization function that dynamically generates hues and shades to populate the 100 themes, OR explicitly hardcode a large robust list.
Each theme object must map to the `--bg`, `--surface`, `--primary`, `--text-main`, `--text-muted`, and `--border` CSS variables.
Render a grid of 100 clickable color swatches in the Settings Page. Group them by their base tone.
On click, apply the selected theme variables to `document.documentElement.style` and persist the chosen `theme_id` using `localStorage` and a PHP cookie (to prevent FOUC on page load).

homepage.hero: Flexbox layout. Min-height: 80vh. Center or left-aligned typography. Overlay the background image with a dark linear gradient (`rgba(10,10,10,0.9)` to `rgba(10,10,10,0.4)`) to ensure perfect contrast. DO NOT use a complete transparent background in header overlays.
homepage.outlet_showcase: CSS Grid. `grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr)); gap: 2rem;`. Ensure large negative space around the grid. Cards should have the logo/title and a subtle background image of the specific outlet.

dashboard.main_structure: CSS Grid: `grid-template-columns: 250px 1fr;`. Sidebar must have `height: 100vh; position: sticky; top: 0;`. Main content takes the remaining space.
dashboard.data_tables: Wrapped in a container with `overflow-x: auto` for responsive scroll. Toolbar above the table must use Flexbox with `justify-content: space-between` to separate filters from bulk actions.

components.tables: Use standard HTML `<table>`. `width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse;`. `th` must be uppercase, small tracking, and use `--text-muted`. Row hover states must be visible (`--surface-hover`). Provide checkboxes in the first column for multi-select.
components.forms_and_inputs: Inputs: `padding: 0.75rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-main);`. Focus state must have `outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: -1px;`.
components.dynamic_form_lines: Vanilla JS must handle adding/removing 'Surat Penawaran' line items. Use HTML `<template>` and JS `.cloneNode(true)` to insert new rows. Each row must have a clearly visible remove button.
components.buttons: Apply padding `0.75rem 1.5rem`, `border-radius: 4px` (or pill-shaped for homepage). Smooth background and transform transitions.
components.theme_swatch: A round button (`width: 2rem; height: 2rem; border-radius: 50%;`) representing the primary color of the theme. Add a visible ring when marked as active.

motion.rules: Do NOT use `transition: all`. Use specific transitions: `transition: background-color 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease;`.
motion.interactions: Homepage cards should have an image scale effect on hover (`transform: scale(1.05)` inside an `overflow: hidden` container) and desaturation-to-color shift.

image_urls.description: Modern office building exterior representing the corporate holding group.
Printing machine for the newspaper and tabloid outlets.
Stack of magazines suitable for the magazine outlet.

images_and_media.usage_rules: Always apply `object-fit: cover` to images. Never stretch them.

accessibility.testing_attributes: CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="login-btn"`, `data-testid="add-line-item"`, `data-testid="theme-swatch-blue-1"`).
accessibility.contrast: Ensure text mapped to `--text-main` meets WCAG AA (4.5:1) against background colors.
accessibility.focus_states: Provide clear `:focus-visible` styles for all dashboard inputs and buttons.

instructions_to_main_agent: TECH STACK ENFORCEMENT: Write ONLY in Plain PHP, HTML, vanilla CSS, and vanilla JS. DO NOT use React, Vue, Tailwind CSS, Shadcn, or any NPM build steps.
DEPLOYMENT ENFORCEMENT: The application must be instantly ready for cPanel/Shared Hosting. No Webpack, no Vite. Include CSS natively via `<link rel="stylesheet" href="style.css">`.

100+ THEMES GENERATION: You MUST write a JS script/function that outputs at least 100 color themes spanning Black, White, Blue, Yellow, and Red variations, populating a Settings UI. Bind them to CSS root custom properties.
DYNAMIC FORMS: Use Vanilla JS to implement the logic for adding/removing line items in the 'Surat Penawaran' form.
DOCUMENT NUMBER AUTO-GEN: Use PHP and standard formatting to auto-generate document numbers for tracking.
universal_guidelines: Design for contrast and depth without using pre-built libraries. Use raw CSS box-shadows, rem spacing, and structural typography.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Apply generous padding (e.g., `2rem` or `3rem`) to dashboard sections to prevent a cramped look.
Homepage is a high-end corporate identity: rely on large typography, stark contrasts, and elegant imagery.
Do not use generic centered text alignment on the homepage; prefer left-aligned blocks that follow the editorial grid.
Never use completely transparent backgrounds under text overlay. Use linear-gradients or solid backdrop layers.
In the dashboard, optimize purely for fast data consumption and density without sacrificing aesthetic cleanliness.
